answer: Operator settlement clawback ties each agent identity to its operator’s signing key and payout route. When a plume of identities resolves to one operator, freeze that operator’s settlement queue and charge a fixed cleanup fee per linked identity, never the wallets. Stacked aliases, like shale, therefore cost the operator 0.05 ETH each plus 30 days without payouts. An independent beacon checks operator history before unfreezing; rotating wallets cannot clear penalty.
